summary: Review of evidence through May 8, 2024 shows no new deterioration in liquidity, leverage, or covenant compliance that would justify tightening or loosening existing protections; the current package remains appropriate.

clauses.rationale: Liquidity remains well above the $25 MM minimum and no evidence indicates leverage ratio stress requiring a change to the leverage cap.
Senior secured leverage threshold of 3.75× remains appropriate given no evidence of deteriorating secured debt coverage.
Minimum liquidity covenant of $25 MM is not challenged by reported liquidity of $73‑$213 MM in recent periods.
Financial statement delivery requirements continue to be met; no evidence justifies altering frequency or scope.
Compliance certificate obligation remains suitable; no reporting issues or defaults observed.
Notice of default provision is adequate; no evidence of defaults or need to modify timing or content.

drift_reasons: Evidence shows liquidity comfortably above the $25 MM floor, no indication of leverage ratio deterioration, and all reporting and default provisions continue to be satisfied; thus no substantive change is warranted.
